Layer: `std`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Blocking libc hostname/service resolution uses explicit ASCII input, address-family, TCP/UDP and flag policies. Native order and duplicates are copied into an owned SocketAddr vector; result caps and unsupported native shapes fail without publishing a partial vector. EAI_SYSTEM retains errno captured before cleanup.
